name: respond-clearly
description: Replies shaped for readers with ADHD, autism, or both: answer first, literal wording, exact state, no surprises. Personalize it with your own profile.

interface.shortDescription: Replies for readers with ADHD, autism, or both
interface.longDescription: Shapes replies so they can be skimmed, taken literally, and acted on: answer first, short sections, exact numbers and state, no surprises, one next step. Reads your personal profile from ~/.config/respond-clearly/profile.md.
defaultPrompt: Give me the answer first and the one thing I need to do.
